Hidden beaches, secret caves, and waters so blue you'll think you're dreaming. 🏝️

The Marieta Islands are one of Mexico's most protected and breathtaking natural wonders — just a short boat ride from Sayulita. A UNESCO-protected reserve where humpback whales, manta rays, and sea turtles call home.

The highlight? The famous Hidden Beach (Playa del Amor) — a beach inside a crater, accessible only by swimming through a tunnel at the right tide. It's as magical as it sounds.
